fact: The policy states ZISPIS has not been fully operationalized and the sector still has fragmented MIS development in silos, with separate registries and distinct payment systems, while ZISPIS is a unified register for key interventions with SWL and the 1,000 Days SCT pilot integrated within it.
title: 2025 National Social Protection Policy
publisher: Republic of Zambia, Ministry of Community Development and Social Services
